effects.label: Shield
effects.description: Gives the recipient a HP Shield. All damage the recipient takes will be subtracted from the Shield first, before their HP.Each Skill can only cast one Shield at a time on each recipient.

Removes a random debuff from the 10 allies with the lowest HP% in a 15m radius. Then, casts a [Shield] buff on the targets, lasting 10s. The [Shield] is equal to (10% * MAX HP + 2% * MAX HP for each debuff removed).
#1 Shield: 10% * MAX HP + 2% * MAX HP for each debuff removed

bio: What are you buying, stranger? Giiya is a peddler of weird and peculiar objects, all of which manage to fit in her ever-bulging backpack. She's happy to haggle over prices, but don't you dare try to steal from her collection of curiosities. You'll be blown to smithereens before you can even get your hand in your pocket.
